# Joint National Committee for Languages (JNCL)

> JNCL advocates for multilingual education and language policy in the United States through congressional engagement, member organizations, and grassroots advocacy.

The Joint National Committee for Languages (JNCL) is a coalition of 130+ language organizations working to advance language education and policy at the federal level since 1972. The organization coordinates Language Advocacy Days, maintains the America's Languages Caucus on Capitol Hill, and provides advocacy resources and toolkits for language education advocates nationwide.
